narratives.Description: bug(routing,cloud): babysit-pull-request-in-cloud dispatch bypasses deft-directive-review-cycle and canonical preamble (#954)
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

When an operator triggers **babysit-pull-request-in-cloud** on a Deft-managed consumer project, the orchestrator may dispatch a cloud subagent using the **generic Cursor `babysit` skill** (`~/.cursor/skills-cursor/babysit/SKILL.md`) instead of **`deft-directive-review-cycle`**, and may omit the **canonical orchestrator preamble** (`templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md`, #954). The worker then improvises a PR-monitoring/fix loop outside Deft process gates (xBRIEF preflight, Phase 1 audit, `deft check`, Greptile exit predicate, CHANGELOG discipline).

This is a **second recurrence** of the intent-routing class documented in #1862, with an additional failure mode: **product-level action name → wrong skill namespace** (Cursor global skill vs Deft vendored skill) plus **cloud Task dispatch without preamble injection**.

## Recurrence record (live incident, 2026-07-03, deftai/deftvisage PR #1037)

### Timeline

1. Operator asked whether open PRs exist → identified [#1037](https://github.com/deftai/deftvisage/pull/1037) (`fix/visage-repo-org-scoping`).
2. Operator selected **babysit-pull-request-in-cloud** with explicit babysit instructions (triage unresolved comments, resolve conflicts against `main`, fix in-scope CI only, never modify workflows).
3. Orchestrator (Cursor agent) dispatched a **cloud background subagent** via Task tool (`environment: cloud`, `run_in_background: true`).
4. Dispatch envelope included:
   - Generic babysit workflow rules (inline + Cursor babysit skill semantics)
   - PR metadata (#1037, branch, repo path)
   - **Did not** include: `deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md`, `templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md`, `## Allocation context`, `## Worker metadata`, session ritual gates, or review-cycle Phase 1 audit requirements.
5. Operator later asked: *"is the babysitter agent using the directive review skill?"* → orchestrator confirmed **no** — only the generic Cursor babysit skill was wired.
6. Cloud worker **did** push useful scoped fixes (2 commits from `cursoragent`):
   - `ab81dce` — log `resolveUserOrg` failures for operator diagnostics
   - `0688643` — distinguish org lookup failures from empty membership (502 vs 422), addressing SLizard P2 on #1037
7. Operator asked: *"while this PR is being fixed is it using DEFT guidelines in the cloud?"* → orchestrator confirmed **mostly no** (pragmatic fixes, not Deft review-cycle process).
8. SLizard posted a **non-blocking** review (`decision: comment`, P2: 1) on head `ab81dce`; cloud worker's subsequent commit `0688643` addressed that P2 without evidence of running the Greptile/SLizard multi-reviewer exit predicate from `deft-directive-review-cycle`.

### What the worker did vs what Deft requires

| Expected (Deft) | Observed (cloud babysit) |
|-----------------|--------------------------|
| Route PR shepherding → `deft-directive-review-cycle` (#1862 intent class) | Routed to Cursor global `babysit` skill |
| Include canonical preamble in dispatch envelope (#954) | Preamble omitted |
| Phase 1 process audit before fix loop (pre-pr, xBRIEF, CHANGELOG, `deft check`, PR template) | Not run (no evidence in commits) |
| Greptile Step 6 fail-closed exit predicate (#1259) | Not evaluated; SLizard P2 fixed ad hoc |
| Batch Phase 1 + Phase 2 fixes per review-cycle discipline | Two separate fix commits pushed without audit trail |
| `worker_role: review-monitor` + explicit skill read mandate | Not declared |

**Net:** Code quality on the fixes appears reasonable; **process compliance was absent**. Merge may proceed on green CI, but the protection layer Deft exists to provide did not apply.

## Root cause analysis

### Primary cause — dual skill namespace collision

Two incompatible skills share the **babysit** name:

| Skill | Location | Scope |
|-------|----------|-------|
| Cursor `babysit` | `~/.cursor/skills-cursor/babysit/SKILL.md` | Generic PR comment/CI/conflict loop |
| Deft review cycle | `.deft/core/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md` | Greptile/SLizard adapter, Phase 1 audit, fail-closed exit |

The Cursor product action **babysit-pull-request-in-cloud** resolves to the **Cursor-global** skill. On a Deft consumer repo, AGENTS.md skill routing expects PR shepherding to chain through **`deft-directive-review-cycle`** (and/or a Deft-native babysit wrapper that chains into it). The orchestrator matched the **action name** instead of the **project's skill router**.

### Contributing cause — keyword routing (#1862)

Even absent the Cursor action, operator phrasing (*"babysit this PR"*, *"Execute the selected diff-tab babysit-pull-request-in-cloud action"*) does not contain literal review-cycle triggers (`review cycle`, `check reviews`, `run review cycle`). The AGENTS.md router never fires; see #1862.

### Contributing cause — cloud dispatch omits preamble (#954)

`AGENTS.md` and `templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` require orchestrators dispatching sub-agents to include the canonical preamble (AGENTS.md read mandate, review-cycle skill mandate, REST-by-default gh reads, rate-limit throttle, worker lifecycle hygiene). The Cursor Task cloud dispatch path has **no automatic preamble injection** — the parent agent must explicitly embed or reference it. The orchestrator did not.

### Contributing cause — "Before Improvising" not enforced at dispatch boundary

The orchestrator had access to `.agents/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md` (project symlink) and the Deft skills index in AGENTS.md, but prioritized the Cursor babysit skill description attached to the UI action without scanning `.deft/core/skills/` for coverage first.

## Impact

- **Silent process bypass:** Review-cycle gates (xBRIEF, CHANGELOG, `deft check`, Greptile terminal predicate) do not run unless the operator catches the miss manually.
- **False confidence:** Useful code fixes + green CI can mask the fact that Deft review discipline was skipped (same blast-radius class as #1862's Greptile-check conflation, though this incident did not claim merge-ready prematurely).
- **Repeatable on every cloud babysit action** until routing/preamble are structural, not behavioral.
- **Multi-reviewer gap (#769):** SLizard findings handled ad hoc; no registry-driven triage path.

## Proposed directions

1. **Deft-native babysit skill (consumer-facing).** Add `.deft/core/skills/deft-directive-babysit/SKILL.md` (or extend review-cycle frontmatter triggers) that:
   - Accepts intent synonyms: `babysit`, `shepherd`, `merge-ready`, `watch the PR`, `babysit-pull-request-in-cloud`
   - **First step:** read and chain into `deft-directive-review-cycle`
   - Explicitly **supersedes** Cursor global babysit on Deft-managed repos

2. **AGENTS.md intent-class routing (#1862 item 1).** Register babysit/shepherd intent class → review-cycle (or deft-directive-babysit wrapper). Cross-reference Cursor product action names in trigger list.

3. **Cloud dispatch preamble gate (deterministic tier candidate).** When `Task(environment=cloud)` dispatches on a repo with `.deft/core/` installed, verifier fails closed unless dispatch prompt references `templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` and a review skill path. Candidate: extend `verify:session-ritual` gated tier or new `verify:dispatch-envelope`.

4. **Cursor product integration note.** Document that **babysit-pull-request-in-cloud** on Deft repos should inject Deft skill paths, not only `skills-cursor/babysit`. May require Cursor-side template change or operator rule.

5. **Anti-pattern in review-cycle SKILL.** Codify: *"A passing SLizard/Greptile check run or ad hoc fix commit is NOT the review-cycle exit predicate (#1259)."* Link #769 for multi-reviewer handling.

## Acceptance (suggested)

- [ ] Intent phrases including `babysit`, `babysit-pull-request-in-cloud`, and `shepherd` route to Deft review-cycle (directly or via wrapper skill) on consumer repos with `.deft/core/` installed.
- [ ] Cloud subagent dispatch documentation + preamble template include a **review-monitor** worked example with explicit skill path and preamble reference.
- [ ] Eval case (#1586 extension): paraphrase *"Execute babysit-pull-request-in-cloud on PR #N"* → must load `deft-directive-review-cycle` (or wrapper), not Cursor global babysit.
- [ ] Optional deterministic gate: cloud/background dispatch on Deft repos warns or fails when preamble/skill paths absent from envelope.

## Related

- #1862 — parent class: intent-shaped PR-shepherding bypasses keyword routing (cartograph PR #68 recurrence)
- #954 — canonical orchestrator preamble requirement
- #1259 — review-cycle fail-closed exit predicate
- #769 — multi-reviewer abstraction (SLizard + Greptile)
- #1586 — trigger coverage evals for AGENTS.md skill routing
- #607 — failure-to-skill protocol
- #1386 — swarm monitor review-cycle ownership enforcement
- #2019 — harness-aware reviewers (Bugbot in review cycle)

## Evidence

- Consumer repo: `deftai/deftvisage`
- PR: https://github.com/deftai/deftvisage/pull/1037
- Cloud agent commits: `ab81dce`, `0688643` (author: `cursoragent`)
- SLizard review head: `ab81dce1a059f4a9a858c60c2b75bd04c7e317f6` (`decision: comment`, P2: 1, `merge_impact: non-blocking`)
